questions.question: What is a triangle?
questions.answer: A triangle is a polygon with three sides and three angles.

questions.question: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°.
Which triangle has all three sides equal?
Fill in the blank: A triangle with exactly two equal sides is called an ______ triangle.
What is a scalene triangle?
questions.answer: A triangle with all three sides of different lengths.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the type of triangle.
Which image represents a right triangle?
An equilateral triangle has three equal angles.
Fill in the blank: A triangle with one angle greater than 90° is called an ______ triangle.
Which triangle has one angle measuring exactly 90°?
What is an acute triangle?
questions.answer: A triangle in which all three angles are less than 90 degrees.

questions.question: Every equilateral triangle is also an isosceles triangle.
Observe the image and identify the triangle.
Which image shows a scalene triangle?
Explain the difference between an equilateral triangle and an isosceles triangle.
questions.answer: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides, while an isosceles triangle has exactly two equal sides.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: A triangle has ______ sides.
A right triangle always has one right angle.
Which triangle has all angles less than 90°?
Why is the sum of the interior angles of a triangle always 180°?
questions.answer: Because of the geometric properties of triangles in Euclidean geometry.

questions.question: Explain the different ways triangles are classified.
questions.answer: Triangles are classified based on their sides (equilateral, isosceles, scalene) and their angles (acute, right, obtuse).
